For alone of the astrologers whom the Byzantines knew, Anubio used this meter. Cf. Kroll, Philol. N. S., XI, 132. F. C.]

summary.headline: Planetary Ingresses and Aspects
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary ingresses, including Hermes, Moon, Saturn, Mars, Jupiter, and the Sun in the angles and places, with effects on wealth, kinship, idleness, danger, enmity, and illness. Anubio’s further teachings describe ingress aspects and Saturn’s contacts with Jupiter and Mars.
